description: Cold Jellyfish Salad is a quintessential Chinese appetizer celebrated for its unique crunchy and chewy texture. This refreshing dish combines rehydrated jellyfish with crisp vegetables, all tossed in a savory, tangy, and often spicy dressing. It is a perfect start to any meal, offering a delightful contrast of flavors and sensations.

instructions.title: Prepare the Jellyfish
instructions.text: If using dried jellyfish, follow package instructions for rehydration, typically involving soaking in cold water for several hours, then rinsing thoroughly. If using pre-packaged rehydrated jellyfish, rinse it under cold running water for a few minutes to remove excess brine and pat dry. Cut into bite-sized pieces if necessary.

instructions.title: Prepare Vegetables and Aromatics
instructions.text: Wash and julienne the cucumber and carrot into thin strips. Peel and finely mince the garlic cloves. These preparations contribute to the salad's texture and flavor profile.

instructions.title: Whisk the Dressing
instructions.text: In a small bowl, combine the light soy sauce, Chinkiang black vinegar, sesame oil, sugar, and minced garlic. Stir well until the sugar is fully dissolved. If you prefer a spicy kick, add 1-2 teaspoons of chili oil and mix thoroughly.

instructions.title: Combine Salad Ingredients
instructions.text: In a large mixing bowl, add the prepared jellyfish, julienned cucumber, and julienned carrot. Ensure all ingredients are evenly distributed before adding the dressing.

instructions.title: Dress and Chill the Salad
instructions.text: Pour the prepared dressing over the jellyfish and vegetable mixture. Toss everything gently but thoroughly to ensure all components are well coated with the dressing. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 35 minutes to allow the flavors to meld and for the salad to chill completely. This chilling time is crucial for the best taste.

instructions.title: Garnish and Serve
instructions.text: Before serving, give the salad another quick toss. Transfer the cold jellyfish salad to a serving dish and sprinkle generously with toasted white sesame seeds for added aroma and crunch. Serve immediately as a refreshing appetizer.

tips: Always rinse jellyfish thoroughly, especially if using pre-packaged, to remove any residual brine which can be very salty. This ensures a clean, fresh taste.
For the best texture, ensure your cucumber and carrot are julienned thinly and uniformly. A mandoline slicer can achieve professional results quickly.

The salad tastes best when chilled for at least 30-45 minutes before serving, allowing the dressing to fully infuse the jellyfish and vegetables. Do not store for more than 1-2 days as the jellyfish can lose its crispness.
